subtitle: Lesson 20 · Error Handling, Logging & Retries

caption: Works every time it's tested. Breaks the first real failure.

eyebrow: Four failure modes to design for

steps.label: Unreachable
steps.sub: network down, DNS failure, or the external system itself is down — the call times out

steps.label: Auth expires
steps.sub: an OAuth token is valid for an hour, then silently isn't

steps.label: Schema changes
steps.sub: a field gets renamed or moved on the external side with no warning

steps.label: Rate limiting
steps.sub: HTTP 429 — the system protecting itself, expecting you to slow down

caption: An unhandled exception doesn't just skip a step — it can abort one.

subtitle: Not every failure deserves the same response.
